profile.name: 是德科技 EXR 系列示波器
profile.description: EXR 系列是一类台式数字示波器，用于采集、显示和分析电子信号波形。它适合实验室中的电路调试、时序观察、信号完整性检查以及多通道信号测量。
profile.description_en: The EXR Series is a family of bench digital oscilloscopes used to acquire, display, and analyze electronic waveforms. It is suitable for laboratory circuit debugging, timing observation, signal integrity checks, and multi-channel signal measurement.
